vulnerabilities.title: Critical MikroTik Vulnerability - Patch Now, (Sun, Sep 6th)
vulnerabilities.summary: MikroTik a publié un correctif pour une vulnérabilité déjà exploitée, permettant un saut de l'authentification SSH. La compromission est probable.

campaigns.summary: Quatre modules associés à REVSTEALER désactivent Windows Update et Defender pour exécuter un minage de cryptomonnaie.

top_reads.title: Four REVSTEALER-Linked Modules Disable Windows Update and Defender to Run a Crypto Miner
top_reads.summary:
Elastic Security Labs has documented four previously unreported programs associated with REVSTEALER, an emerging Windows information stealer, that remain on an infected machine after the stealer deletes itself.

One of them switches off Windows Update and Microsoft Defender before running a cryptocurrency miner.
